answer: PagedAttention solves the memory inefficiency and high computational cost associated with traditional attention mechanisms, particularly in long sequence processing. It achieves this by implementing a memory management system similar to virtual memory paging, allowing for more efficient and flexible handling of attention computations.

PagedAttention solves the memory inefficiency and high computational cost associated with traditional attention mechanisms in large language models. It achieves this by implementing a memory management system similar to virtual memory for attention keys and values, allowing for more efficient handling of long sequences and larger contexts.
